notes: CONFIRMED in playtest ember-road s1: same party notes analysed for 5 PCs -> each got 17-19 events incl. everyone else's (Tovin credited with Maren's bake-off, Wick's ox ride...). All five hit GD level 3 from one session. Fix: filter/attribute by actorName vs actor.name (+aliases), or analyse once per party and split.
